purpose: Define deterministic preset-to-UE4-quality-group mapping and Custom-state semantics without implementing runtime code before ProjectGovernor and WORLD_DETAIL_LEDGER authority registration.

authority_boundary.rule: If this mapping conflicts with ProjectGovernor or WORLD_DETAIL_LEDGER after authority registration, authority wins and this mapping must be revised before implementation.

engine_model.resolution_scale_rule: Resolution scale participates in named-preset matching because the Performance and Balanced floor contract requires native 1280x720 at 100% scale.

Performance.intent: Native-720p safety-floor candidate for target-device validation; not performance-accepted.

Balanced.intent: Visually strong default candidate; not performance-accepted.

Cinematic.intent: Presentation-first candidate that still obeys visual economy instead of blindly maximizing expensive groups.

select_named_preset: Set only mapped quality groups and the preset resolution scale.
Do not silently change display mode, output resolution, VSync, or frame-rate limit.
Do not persist until Apply succeeds.
custom_detection: Compare current working quality-group values plus resolution scale against every named preset.
If exactly one named preset matches, display that preset name.
Display-only controls do not by themselves change a named quality preset to Custom.
preset_selection_semantics.manual_quality_change: Changing any mapped quality group or resolution scale re-evaluates the named-preset match immediately.
preset_selection_semantics.restore_defaults: Restore the project default candidate working values, including Balanced quality mapping and safe display defaults, but do not persist until Apply.
preset_selection_semantics.revert: Restore the last applied working values without changing persisted settings.

quality_only_change: Apply quality settings through the UGameUserSettings path.
Save only after the apply path succeeds.
display_mode_or_resolution_change: Apply the candidate display change without discarding the last confirmed display state.
On timeout or rejection, restore the last confirmed display state.
apply_and_safety_order.invalid_persisted_value: Clamp unsupported quality values and replace unsupported display values with safe project defaults before exposing the settings UI.

visual_economy_constraints.texture_budget: Do not encode a fixed streaming-pool increase without measured target-device VRAM evidence.

static_validation_backlog: Every named preset maps every declared quality group exactly once.
Every mapped quality value is an integer in the inclusive range 0..3.
Performance and Balanced both remain at 100% resolution scale.
Selecting a named preset cannot silently alter display mode, output resolution, VSync, or frame-rate limit.
Cinematic does not blindly maximize shadows, effects, or foliage.
A quality-group edit that no longer matches a named preset resolves to Custom.
No fixed texture streaming-pool increase is introduced without target-device evidence.
